name: Infantry_OpenCode
author: Infantry AI
description: The opencode harness (HARNESS H8b-2/3): launches opencode (run --format json, or the persistent opencode serve over HTTP/SSE), maps tool approval to its permissions, merges the session's MCP server and the watch plugin into its inline config, lists its models carries the / command catalog and reads its session store.

credential.label: OpenCode Go
credential.help: Create an API key in your OpenCode account (opencode.ai) and paste it here. Only needed for the paid OpenCode Go models; the free tier needs none.

credentials.label: Command Code
credentials.help: Create an API key at commandcode.ai. Only needed for the commandcode/* models; the key is read by opencode's commandcode provider from CMD_API_KEY.

credentials.label: DeepSeek
credentials.help: Create an API key at platform.deepseek.com. Only needed for the deepseek/* models.

credentials.label: Google Gemini
credentials.help: Create an API key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Only needed for the google/* models.

credentials.label: Moonshot (Kimi)
credentials.help: Create an API key at platform.moonshot.ai. Only needed for the moonshotai/* models.

credentials.label: Alibaba (Qwen)
credentials.help: Create a DashScope API key in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. Only needed for the alibaba/* models.
